causal_contrast: Same checkpoint and exact tokenized rows, varying only the preregistered forward configuration.
competing_hypotheses: The observed drift is ordinary BF16, padding, or batching sensitivity and no stable NLL mode is available under the current runtime.
The drift is caused by a controllable implementation detail such as padding side, position IDs, attention masking, token shift, or aggregation.
A stable token-level NLL mode exists but remains scientifically insufficient to predict exact-grid DEV generalization.

conditions.aggregation: Primary token-micro mean NLL over non-ignored causal target tokens; row-macro NLL is secondary and cannot replace the primary metric.
conditions.checkpoints: Reuse only the three immutable conditions already bound by the closed branch; no checkpoint mutation or optimizer construction.
forward_modes: BF16 Batch1, repeated fixed number of forwards
BF16 length-bucketed Batch32 with the frozen fallback ladder, repeated fixed number of forwards
One independently specified precision or padding/position control only if static inspection identifies a concrete implementation distinction
conditions.rows: A newly frozen, deterministic, family-stratified subset of the existing TRAIN rows only. No DEV, retention, diagnostic Gold, or FINAL_AUDIT labels are loaded.

controls: recorded dtype, padding side, attention mask, position IDs, and causal shift
experimental_unit: One frozen, target-blind TRAIN row under one frozen checkpoint and one specified forward configuration.
forbidden: DEV or retention labels in NLL

primary: within_mode repeated-forward maximum absolute token-micro NLL drift

positive_negative_inconclusive_branches.inconclusive: Fix only the identified measurement implementation defect, then require a fresh review before any rerun.
positive_negative_inconclusive_branches.negative: No stable mode establishes that token-NLL mechanism claims are not currently supportable; prefer another research route.
positive_negative_inconclusive_branches.positive: A valid stable reference NLL mode permits a separate mechanism study proposal; it does not establish fitting or generalization.

primary_hypothesis: A fixed forward configuration can be identified whose repeated-forward and Batch1-versus-batched variation is bounded tightly enough to support later checkpoint comparisons.

prospective_decision_rule.measurement_invalid: If the same raw rows and model exhibit unresolved configuration-dependent NLL drift beyond the prospective rule, record INCONCLUSIVE_MEASUREMENT and do not classify H1, H2, or H3.
prospective_decision_rule.measurement_valid: Only if the preregistered reference mode is repeatable and its fixed Batch1/batched comparison meets the acceptance rule established before checkpoint-comparison interpretation.
prospective_decision_rule.scope: This study validates a measurement procedure only. It does not authorize training, R3, composition training, or a causal claim about generalization.

research_question: Can a prospectively specified no-update NLL measurement mode distinguish genuine checkpoint-level fit differences from numerical or batch-composition artifacts?
